runtime_choices.B12X_W4A8_TINY_DECODE: 0 (tiny decode omits swiglu_limit; see experiment README)
runtime_choices.B12X_AUTOTUNE: 0 (autotune race budget is free memory // 2 on unified memory)
runtime_choices.speculative: DSpark, 5 tokens (the drafter's trained block), draft TP 3, adaptive verification cost scale 2 on curves profiled for this image (tp3-b12x-512k-20261005), dead verification rows below survival 0.2, block rejection; greedy drafts vocabulary-parallel (vLLM patch 0012) over the checkpoint's BF16 draft head (the target head's own tensor) and BF16 Markov projection (VLLM_DS41_DRAFT_NVFP4_HEAD=0, VLLM_DS41_MARKOV_NVFP4=0), and a column-sharded drafter main_proj (0013)
runtime_choices.cudagraph: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE, capture sizes 1-48 (adds 40 and 48 for eight streams at 1 + 5 rows)
runtime_choices.flashinfer_autotune: disabled (--no-enable-flashinfer-autotune): it saved 0 configs, and only the sampler uses FlashInfer
runtime_choices.engram_projection: sharded across ranks (projection_tp, padded to 25632 rows by vLLM patch 0001)
runtime_choices.engram_rows: read beside the forward launch (SPARK3_ENGRAM_ASYNC=1, vLLM patch 0002 re-ported); the base's Engram overlap is off (VLLM_DS41_ENGRAM_OVERLAP=0)
runtime_choices.multimodal: vision tower loaded (no --language-model-only), up to 4 images per request; --mm-processor-cache-gb 0 (vLLM's default 4 GiB host cache would come out of dgx1's guard margin)
runtime_choices.host_sysctl: vm.watermark_boost_factor=0 on every node (/etc/sysctl.d/90-watermark-boost.conf): a watermark boost hides up to 0.87 GiB from MemAvailable, which the memory guards read
runtime_choices.l2_prefetch: on (the base's default on SM121): side-stream L2 prefetch of the next decode projections; it compiles from r5i on (quack-kernels needs CuTe DSL 4.7), so earlier baselines recorded it on while it disabled itself at startup
runtime_choices.nccl: 2.30.7 rebuilt with patches/nccl (NVIDIA/nccl#2393 IB send-path fence and the four-node ring patches) in place of the base image's wheel
runtime_choices.chat_template_defaults: none: thinking is the default when a request names neither key, so a client's enable_thinking=false is honored
runtime_choices.prefill: sequence-parallel once a forward's reduce-scatter exceeds the one-shot RoCE all-reduce (205 tokens at TP 3; vLLM patches 0014-0018, no setting): per-layer all-reduces become reduce-scatters, row-wise work runs on a third of the rows, CED encoder layers only
runtime_choices.host: mutating torch custom ops read their argument schema once per call (vLLM patch 0019, vllm/env_override.py), not once per argument
runtime_choices.cutlass_dsl: 4.7.1 for every consumer (vLLM, quack-kernels, B12X via patch 0002, FlashInfer, cuDNN frontend)
runtime_choices.jit_caches: driver PTX JIT cache (CUDA_CACHE_PATH, 4 GiB limit) and TileLang cache on the /cache mount, beside the B12X, CuTe DSL, FlashInfer and Triton caches
runtime_choices.jit_warmup: the dead-row variants of the draft combine and sampled/rejected-count Triton kernels are compiled at warmup (vLLM patch 0020); no kernel compiles after readiness
runtime_choices.display_carveout: SPARK3_DISPLAY_CARVEOUT_WEIGHTS=1 with the GB10 display device passed to the container: embed_tokens and the packed lm_head are created in the firmware scanout reserve and the checkpoint loader writes straight into them (vLLM 0030); the text console keeps its 8 MiB framebuffer
runtime_choices.attention_compute: VLLM_DS41_ATTENTION_COMPUTE=auto (B12X's tuned arithmetic; BF16 pending a fidelity test)
runtime_choices.indexer_split: always under sequence-parallel prefill (patch 0025; SPARK3_DS41_INDEXER_SPLIT_CHECK=1 validates it against the full-row indexer)
runtime_choices.topk_ties: lowest logical position (B12X 0003); indexer selections repeat exactly
runtime_choices.dense_gemm_stage_release: async-proxy fence before each TMA-refilled stage release (B12X 0004)
runtime_choices.prefill_stage_release: async-proxy fence before each TMA-refilled stage release in the BF16 and mHC prefill projections and contiguous attention (B12X 0005)
runtime_choices.host_memory: 64 KiB pages; memory-saver DKMS 0.2.0, UVM leaf-table packing enabled; THP never, vm.min_free_kbytes=45166, /swap-64k.img
runtime_choices.vocabulary_head: exact 12-bit packed BF16 (VLLM_DS41_PACKED_BF16_LM_HEAD=1; B12X 0012, vLLM 0028): a 4-bit exponent window code plus a per-row list of out-of-window values, bit-identical to the BF16 weights
runtime_choices.collective_policy: the requested RoCE collective policy is explicit and enforced (vLLM 0027): a declined or lost RoCE backend fails startup instead of falling back to another path
runtime_choices.profiling_context: the fabricated context of startup profiling and dummy runs takes its own blocks per KV cache group and request (vLLM 0039), so no group reads another group's records
runtime_choices.four_node_transports: present in the image and inactive at TP3: B12X 0006-0011 (RoCEnante ring relay, NIC-forwarded mesh, four-path mesh, bidirectional relay, dispatch capacity, loader ABI) and NCCL 0002-0004 (bidirectional switchless rings, balanced channels, adaptive small-ring threads)

change_from_previous: Native BF16 drafter heads in place of load-time NVFP4 re-quantization, the exact 12-bit packed BF16 vocabulary head, vocabulary weights loaded straight into the display carve-out, the explicit RoCE collective policy and the fabricated profiling context's own blocks, on a new image that also carries the four-node transport patches. The TP3 shape, memory guards and weights are unchanged. The same image serves the TP4 1M recipe (the tp4 tuning profile).

evidence.summary: Owner acceptance: one benchmark per configuration at its limits. TP3 on the dgx1-dgx3 triangle (2026-10-05 01:10-01:22 UTC): quality 5/5; decode prose 50.4/75.9/118.8/173.3 and code 60.1/90.8/136.3/192.3 tok/s at 1/2/4/8 streams, every point the same as r5o within its interval; single-stream steps 41.92/46.44 ms against 40.84/45.36 (the native heads); real-text prefill 3,778/3,632/3,432 tok/s at 32K/256K/500K; minimum MemAvailable 5.93/7.11/7.19 GiB; no thermal slowdown. TP4 recipe on the ring (00:10-00:26 UTC): quality 5/5; decode prose 62.1-297.3 and code 72.5-323.5 tok/s at 1-16 streams; prefill 5,117/4,873/4,026 tok/s at 32K/256K/1M; minimum MemAvailable 20.4 GiB.
